title: Steel Structures in Puntarenas, Costa Rica | MA Soluciones
description: Steel structure design, fabrication and assembly in Puntarenas and the Central Pacific: industrial warehouses, roofs, mezzanines and large trusses.
ogTitle: Steel Structure Design & Assembly | MA Soluciones Integrales
h1: Steel Structures in Puntarenas and the Central Pacific
lead: We design, fabricate and assemble steel structures for industrial warehouses, galeras, roofs, mezzanines and large trusses, built with certified steel for the humid Pacific climate.
heroAlt: Steel structure assembly by MA Soluciones in Puntarenas, Costa Rica

faqs.q: What types of steel structures do you build?
faqs.a: Industrial warehouses, galeras, roofs, mezzanines and large trusses, as well as stairs, railings and walkways. We handle design, fabrication and assembly under one contract.
Yes. We use certified structural steel and follow international welding standards so every weld and connection meets the requirements for buildings in the Central Pacific.

faqs.q: How is steel protected from the coastal climate?
faqs.a: We apply protection systems designed for saline, humid air — surface preparation, anti-corrosive coatings and the correct selection of fasteners — so your structure lasts in Pacífico conditions.
